name: Protein-RNA interaction benchmark
description: A systematic benchmarking study and dataset assembly that evaluates and compares machine learning methods for predicting protein–RNA interactions.
reputation: Moderately used in the protein–RNA modeling community as a standard dataset for comparing binding and site-prediction methods.
notes: Often a small, imbalanced dataset with experimental noise; potential for train/test contamination if homologous sequences are not properly separated; focuses on non-LLM bioinformatics models and binding-site formulations vary across studies.
